lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 2008, this man was borrowing money to pay his rent.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Three rockets had blown up. His car company was dying. His marriage was over.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He had enough money for one last launch.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And holy shit. It reached orbit.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Days later, NASA signs a 1.6 billion dollar contract. On Christmas Eve, Tesla is saved.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: SpaceX goes public. The biggest stock market debut in history.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And Elon Musk becomes the first trillionaire. Ever.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Three months later, on September 28th, exactly eighteen years after Falcon 1, Starship reaches orbit.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Same date. Same guy. Very different rocket.
